gate.meaning: Practical non-inferiority screen, not a significance test or automatic submission approval. A new candidate is recommended for parent review only if it meets all guards and shows a positive pooled primary or H12 delta. The user permits a smaller or temporally mixed but still competitive external candidate; MAIN retains candidate selection and submission ownership.
